title: Te Wairua Taonga i Pātai ki te Mana
intro: I roto i ngā pukapuka o te Quran, i noho tētahi tangata rongonui, ā, ko ōna taonga me ōna mātauranga i rongonui ai. I puta mai tēnei wairua i te whenua me ōna whakapaipai me ōna taonga i miharo ai te hunga mātakitaki, engari i whakakake tōna ngākau i te whakapehapeha. Hono mai ki a mātou i a mātou e wetewete ana i te mea ngaro o tētahi o ngā kōrero whakatūpato o te Quran, te wāhi e tūtaki ai te rangatira o te ao ki te mutunga whakaiti i raro i te whenua i whānau ai ō rātou taonga.
clues: I puta mai ahau i te whenua, he mea whakapaipai ki ngā whakapaipai i hopu i te titiro a te katoa.
He nui te taonga i a au, ā, he hohonu hoki te mātauranga i wehewehe ai ahau i ētahi atu.
I te taenga mai o tētahi karere ki te karanga i te iwi ki a Allah, ka whakahē ahau i tō rātou mana me te whakapehapeha.
I kōrero pōhēhē te hunga i tōku taha, ehara i te atawhai o Allah te pūtake o ōku taonga.
I miharo tōku iwi ki tōku nui, ā, i hiahia kia rite tō rātou mutunga ki tōku.
I horomia katoatia aku hanganga whakahīhī ki te whenua hei whiu atua.

Te whakahē whakapehapeha i te mana o te poropiti

trial.answer: Te whakahē whakapehapeha i te mana o te poropiti

outcome.answer: Horomia ana e te whenua me ana taonga katoa

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
